title: history_deleted v1
description: Written only by the server (device_id "server") when the user deletes listening history with DELETE /v1/history. A device that pulls it deletes its local events of the listed types with from_ms <= at_ms < to_ms, including unsynced ones, and keeps this event.

types.description: Event types removed: play, transition, dj_session, app_session, search.
